items.rationale: The confirmed surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4, and the endorsement waives the 50% reduction. An equivalent pre-loss system is estimated at €650 gross under 7.1.9; the combined appliance estimate is below the €5,000 event cap.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes delivery of replacement equipment even when billed by the supplier on the same invoice. The €25 figure is conditional only.
Clause 7.1.8(c) excludes installing and setting up replacement equipment, even if the original equipment was installed. The €85 figure is conditional only.

The confirmed surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4. An equivalent pre-loss TV is estimated at €1,030 gross under 7.1.9, with no surge-protection reduction; the two appliances total €1,680 against the €5,000 cap, and no deductible is stated.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: Under 3.1.4 and 11.2, the combined property-and-liability charge is excluded in full because no physical-damage element is separately itemised and priced. The €100 figure is conditional only.
Clauses 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude charges for placing an order under the property-and-liability service arrangement. The €25 figure is conditional only.
Clause 7.1.8(d) permits an attendance charge only alongside indemnifiable work on the same invoice, and neither building-services line qualifies. The €25 figure is conditional only.
